notes: Accepted-ballot, fresh-chain, candidate-count, and eligible-set campaigns answer distinct performance questions.
C8B final values are explicitly sourced from measuredSummary, not warmupSummary.
Candidate-count gas differences are transaction-level configuration sensitivity, not isolated candidateCount opcode cost.
Eligible-set M2 is integrated snapshot/root/target-path construction, not isolated path extraction.
Eligible-set M3-M5 remain fixed-depth circuit/proving stages and their variation is descriptive.
No on-chain eligible-set scaling claim is made.
Local receipt/cryptographic latency is not directly compared with biometric/IoT end-to-end voting latency.
